scope: Action-level preservation and ownership. Source or route presence never means implemented, authorized, tested, or release-qualified.

securityInvariants.rule: A public/root loader never grants asset, album, share, project, or administrator access; page and resource authorization remain authoritative.
Marking or unmarking Sensitive changes classification only and preserves album membership; legacy locked visibility remains readable fallback.
Duplicate rows, counts, history, thumbnails, exports, and actions remain visible only to the signed-in asset owner.
